name: Marcel Poitier
original_name: マルセル・ポワティエ
source: A general goods trader in Paris, who sells [url=/c74644]Yanagishita[/url] the Burning Hammer bottles. He tries to give away a set of Indonesian dolls set to curse anyone who owns them, unintentionally handing them off to Yanagishita.
